title: Successive list drops
statement: Let $E$, $s$, and $r$ be finite bit strings, and let $p$ be a natural number. If removing the first $p$ bits of $E$ leaves the concatenation of $s$ and $r$, then removing the first $p+|s|$ bits of $E$ leaves $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ with its first $p$ entries removed equals $s$ followed by $r$
